### Stack & Responsibilities
- Software Engineer building production web applications and AI capabilities for STV’s client engagements. Translating ambiguous consulting problems into shipped software with a senior engineering team.
Software Engineer building AI-enabled web applications for STV’s consulting clients
- Salary: $95,976 - $109,687 per year
- Tech stack: Azure, Cloud, Google Cloud Platform, Node.js, Python, React, TypeScript, Go, .NET
- Visa sponsorship signal: company profile says it sponsors H1B visas. Treat as a small scoring bonus, not a guarantee for this role.
- Visa sponsorship signal: company profile says it sponsors UK Skilled Worker visas.
- Design and build modern web applications, including frontend, backend, and integrations, for client engagements
- Partner with project leads, designers, and client stakeholders to scope features and define technical approaches
- Use AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot in the daily workflow
- Integrate LLMs, RAG pipelines, and other AI capabilities into client-facing products
- Translate ambiguous client requirements into technical plans and ship working software
- Present work, tradeoffs, and recommendations to non-technical client audiences
- Contribute to internal tooling, code reviews, and shared engineering practices
- Iterate directly with clients and take end-to-end ownership of shipped work
- 3+ years building and shipping production web applications
- Strong proficiency with React/TypeScript on the frontend and at least one server-side language: Node, Go, Python, or C#/.NET
- Demonstrated experience using AI-assisted development tools in real work
- Excellent written and verbal communication
- Comfortable presenting to clients and writing documentation
- Experience working in client-facing, consulting, or product-services environments, or a clear interest in moving into one
- Working knowledge of cloud platforms; Azure or GCP preferred
- This position is not eligible for sponsorship

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Software Engineer building production web applications and AI capabilities for STV’s client engagements. Translating ambiguous consulting problems into shipped software with a senior engineering team.
Software Engineer building AI-enabled web applications for STV’s consulting clients
Role description:
• Design and build modern web applications, including frontend, backend, and integrations, for client engagements
• Partner with project leads, designers, and client stakeholders to scope features and define technical approaches
• Use AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot in the daily workflow
• Integrate LLMs, RAG pipelines, and other AI capabilities into client-facing products
• Translate ambiguous client requirements into technical plans and ship working software
• Present work, tradeoffs, and recommendations to non-technical client audiences
• Contribute to internal tooling, code reviews, and shared engineering practices
• Iterate directly with clients and take end-to-end ownership of shipped work
• Push back, propose alternatives, and help shape the product
Role requirements:
• 3+ years building and shipping production web applications
• Strong proficiency with React/TypeScript on the frontend and at least one server-side language: Node, Go, Python, or C#/.NET
• Demonstrated experience using AI-assisted development tools in real work
• Excellent written and verbal communication
• Comfortable presenting to clients and writing documentation
• Experience working in client-facing, consulting, or product-services environments, or a clear interest in moving into one
• Working knowledge of cloud platforms; Azure or GCP preferred
• This position is not eligible for sponsorship
• Experience integrating LLMs, vector databases, or vision models into production applications is a nice-to-have
• Background in infrastructure, transportation, AEC, or adjacent industries STV serves is a nice-to-have
• Comfort working across the stack and picking up unfamiliar technologies quickly is a nice-to-have
• Side projects, open-source contributions, or writing demonstrating curiosity and craft are a nice-to-have
Benefits:
• Health insurance, including an option with a Health Savings Account
• Dental insurance
• Vision insurance
• Flexible Spending Accounts (Healthcare, Dependent Care and Transit and Parking where applicable)
• Disability insurance
• Life Insurance and Accidental Death & Dismemberment
• 401(k) Plan
• Retirement Counseling
• Employee Assistance Program
• Paid Time Off
• Paid Holidays
• Back-Up Dependent Care
• Parental Leave
• Continuing Education Program
• Professional Licensure and Society Memberships
Tech stack:
Azure, Cloud, Google Cloud Platform, Node.js, Python, React, TypeScript, Go, .NET
